entries.text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_01

entries.text: You all gave everything you had on the midterm\nexams. Well done![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_02

entries.text: We’ll resume our regular classes today, so keep\nup that energy for the second half of the term![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_03

entries.text: Have you all been using the R Button to send out\nyour Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_04

entries.text: If you do, your Pokémon will run off in the\ndirection you’re facing.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_05

entries.text: It’s a super-useful tactic that lets your Pokémon\npick up faraway items for you. And that’s not all![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_06

entries.text: If there’s a wild Pokémon near where you sent\nyour Pokémon, they’ll start battling each other![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_07

entries.text: We call those battles...Auto Battles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_08

entries.text: Just as the name implies, your Pokémon will\nact on its own during Auto Battles—meaning\r\nyou won’t have to give it any commands![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_09

entries.text: And if your Pokémon wins, it’ll get Exp. Points\njust like it would in a regular battle.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_10

entries.text: If you make good use of these battles, they can\nbe a really efficient way to train your party![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_11

entries.text: But you’ll want to remember that Pokémon won’t\nevolve or learn new moves right away if they level\r\nup from an Auto Battle.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_12

entries.text: Also, if a Pokémon LOSES an Auto Battle, it’ll\ncome back with just a small amount of HP left.\r\nMake sure to heal it up right away![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_13

entries.text: Whoops. I just about did the whole class as a\none-sided lecture. Does anyone have any\r\nquestions so far?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_14

entries.text: How do I stop an Auto Battle?
entries.label: class_e_05_select_01

entries.text: Can I catch wild Pokémon in Auto Battles?
entries.label: class_e_05_select_02

entries.text: No questions here!
entries.label: class_e_05_select_03

entries.text:
There’s no stopping an Auto Battle once it starts!
You’ll have to wait and see how it plays out!\c
You can call your Pokémon off before the battle
starts, though, if you press the ZR Button while
your Pokémon is still on its way to the opponent![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_answer_01

entries.text:
If you let your Pokémon battle on its own, it’ll
keep going until its opponent is defeated!\c
If you want to catch a wild Pokémon, you’ll need
to battle by issuing commands instead![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_answer_02

entries.text: Great! You’re all really good at this. I can’t wait\nto see where you go from here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_answer_03

entries.text: Even during Auto Battles, our Pokémon are out\nthere battling for us—their Trainers![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_15

entries.text: Keep an eye on them as much as possible, and\nif it looks like they’re going to lose, be sure to\r\nhave them retreat![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_16

entries.text: Also, this goes without saying, but Pokémon with\nlow HP are already worn out.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_17

entries.text: They probably won’t enjoy Auto Battles as much,\nso don’t work them too hard, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_18

entries.text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_19

entries.text: Auto Battles only work if a Trainer and their\nPokémon have a relationship of mutual trust![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_20

entries.text: Be smart with how you use Auto Battles so you\ndon’t lose the trust of your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_21

entries.text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’ve run out of time, as usual...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_22

entries.text: Class is over for now! Take care, you little rascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: class_e_05_battle_23
